resource.title: [Jules Task 7] Express Backend Lifecycle & SSE Mutex Suite
resource.prompt:
Create unit and integration tests in tests/ for Express Dashboard Backend lifecycle, services, and SSE concurrency:
1. Test dashboard/services/taskManager.js and server.cjs: child process lifecycle, mutex locking with isTaskRunning(), SIGINT/SIGTERM process cleanup, and 409 Conflict rejection prevention.
2. Test dashboard/routes/ (boqRoutes.cjs, catalogRoutes.cjs, telemetryRoutes.cjs): REST error envelopes, path validation, and SSE event streaming.
Ensure all tests pass with npm run test:all.
